request.query: Studies of the UCI Online Shoppers Purchasing Intention Dataset or comparable session-level ecommerce datasets that model nonlinear or saturating product-page duration/dwell associations with purchase, especially curvature differences between new and returning visitors.
request.missing_relation: Whether nonlinear or saturating session dwell-purchase associations, including visitor-type moderation, have already been directly studied.
request.change_if_found: If close work exists, frame this as a replication or identify a distinct measurement or comparison before making a novelty claim; metadata-only search results do not verify a gap.
